config_before.description: Earnings-catalyst opening-range breakout, long only and flat by close. Retains v2 selection and opening-range-low stop. v3 sizes each position to at most 0.25% session-opening capital at its modeled stop (including entry and exit costs), subject to the original 20% notional cap and a 1% session loss budget across realized losses and remaining stop exposure. Gaps can exceed modeled limits. Trailing-stop proposal was tested and rejected; profitability remains unproven.

portfolio.account: cash account, T+1 settlement: each dollar of settled cash can fund one buy per day; sale proceeds are reusable the next session

selection.note: Relative volume = volume of today's 09:30-09:35 bar / average volume of the same bar over the previous 14 sessions. Decided after the first bar completes (09:35 ET).
selection.note_v2: v2: only stocks in play whose earnings reaction day is today (Nasdaq earnings calendar: reported after yesterday's close or before today's open)

entry.type: buy stop at the first 5-minute bar's high
entry.same_bar_stop_assumption: if the entry bar's low also reaches the stop, assume the stop was hit (worst case)

exit.exit_at_close: sell at the close of the last 5-minute bar of the session
exit.note: v2: stop at the low of the first 5-minute bar (was 0.10 x ATR, which normal noise kept hitting)

risk.note: Entry sizing: at most 0.25% opening capital lost at each modeled stop; all existing stops plus realized losses must fit a 1% session budget. Gap risk remains. 5% end-of-session drawdown pauses entries; 10% halts the book.

veto_on: hard negatives: offerings, investigations, restatements, bankruptcy, delisting

execution.note: Entries, stops and exits are processed on 1-minute bars (the resolution used in the source paper). The 5-minute pre-registered test was dominated by the same-bar stop ambiguity (113 of 142 trades); see research/PREREGISTRATION.md.
